description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Issuance of Certificate of Exemption (Simakvin Real Estate (pvt) Ltd and 2 Others)
categorisation: This gazette notification is a legal/regulatory matter involving the issuance of certificates of exemption from licensing requirements under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009. It represents a regulatory action by the Public Utilities Commission exercising statutory powers, which falls under legal framework and regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
